name: app-tilted-phone-on-lime-velvet-travel-planner
title: Tilted Phone on Lime Velvet
whatItIs: A phone showing a travel planner form tilted diagonally across a curved lime-green velvet form, with a lime-and-forest-green interface that matches the surroundings.
whatItMeans: Matching the UI palette to the physical backdrop makes the app feel like part of the material world. The rich tactile fabric adds warmth and desirability.
techniques: Monochrome scene where the UI colors echo the environment
Steep diagonal placement of the device for energy
Soft directional light and shadow on textured fabric
Lime primary button against deep green selected chips
bestFor: Portfolio hero shots for mobile projects

vocabulary.definition: A composition built from one hue family so subject and setting agree.
A phone rotated off-axis to add movement.
A rounded navigation pill hovering above the content.
